note: Canonical web-next performance scenarios + budgets (mirrors config/performance/contract.json culture). Budgets gate local + CI runs of perf/run.mjs against a production build (`next start` on localhost, headless Chromium). Baselines live in BASELINE.md; refresh them before tightening a budget. Pending scenarios are declared here so the runner and budgets exist before their surfaces land — the runner reports them as pending and never fails on them.

methodology.paint_timing: waitForFunction polls on requestAnimationFrame, so 'painted' means the frame after the DOM change — within one frame of true paint.
methodology.long_tasks: PerformanceObserver longtask entries, observed in-page. The longtask API only reports tasks >= 50ms, so longest_task_ms reads 0 in a clean run and any nonzero value is a budget violation.
methodology.tbt: Sum of (longtask duration - 50ms) for buffered long tasks within the settle window after navigation.
methodology.first_load_js: Gzipped size of the route's client JS chunks from the .next build manifests — same basis as the `next build` First Load JS column.

scenarios.description: On /spike, submit a message to the mock provider; time from submit to the first assistant token painted.
